name: Polyquaternium 46
description: Polyquaternium-46 (CAS 174761-16-1 ) is a cationic conditioning polymer used primarily in hair care formulations. It delivers film-forming and fixative performance across rinse-off and leave-on systems. This versatile ingredient is a go-to for formulators targeting hold, conditioning, and manageability in a single polymer. In hair styling products such as gels, mousses, and sprays, it provides strong hold. The polymer offers excellent humidity resistance while maintaining a non-tacky feel on the hair shaft. Shampoo and conditioner formulators incorporate it to deposit a conditioning film that improves combability. It effectively reduces static after rinsing, enhancing the overall sensory profile of hair care products. In textile finishing, it modifies fiber surfaces to improve softness and antistatic performance. The chemical is utilized in fabric treatment baths and paper processing operations for surface modification. Its cationic charge aids in uniform coating adhesion and surface uniformity for leather processing. Polyquaternium-46 is supplied as an aqueous solution with active polymer content standardized for direct use. It is available in cosmetic-grade specification suitable for high-end personal care applications. Industrial grades for textile and paper processing are also sourced to meet specific manufacturing needs.
